descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-11 ER 2; TFA-92589 AC 4 · “Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only (per retention rules, 3.6).”. Mixed: stated part — 2-days-ago hidden, yesterday and today shown; our part — editing the timeline, adding a line and reloading (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S06 Hospital day window: two days ago hidden, yesterday and today shown

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules. (UAT TC-11; UAT 3.6; TFA-92589 AC 4)
  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Hospital ledger with lines for 2 days ago, yesterday and today

When Open the chart; edit the timeline, add a line for today, save, reload

Then The cards show yesterday and today only; the 2-days-ago line is not on the cards; the added line shows after save and after reload

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in course-timeline.spec.ts (toHaveCount(0) for the older card). Order is not checked by this spec and is not claimed here (S01, S18). The spec also asserts the editor still holds the 2-days-ago line (textarea toHaveValue), which is Quinn's reading of Q2: a failure at that step or the post-edit steps is recorded under Q2 / T5, not as a U3 Fail

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S06

Hospital day window: two days ago hidden, yesterday and today shown

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-11.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • course-timeline.spec.ts [chromium] — the hospital course shows yesterday and today and the editor holds every line — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec in e2e/course-timeline.spec.ts, chromium): it makes a fresh @roundai.test account and seeds the ledger through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
